long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in Madeira, Ronaldo left home for Sporting's Lisbon academy at twelve and reached its senior side as a teenager. Manchester United developed his explosive wing play into a more complete scoring game, and Real Madrid made him its leading goalscorer. Later moves to Juventus and Saudi Arabia extended a career built on training discipline, adaptability and repeated reinvention.

Commercial success grew alongside football. A long Nike relationship, other global endorsements and branded clothing, fragrance, fitness and hotel ventures broadened his income beyond match earnings. His Portugal career supplied another durable dimension: captaincy, a European Championship title and men's international records for appearances and goals.

Wikipedia

Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Manchester United and captains the Portugal national team. Often considered the best player in the world and widely regarded as one of the greatest players of all time, Ronaldo has won five Ballon d'Or awards and four European Golden Shoes, the most by a European player. He has won 32 trophies in his career, including seven league titles, five UEFA Champions Leagues, one UEFA European Championship, and one UEFA Nations League. Ronaldo holds the records for most appearances (182), most goals (140), and assists (42) in the Champions League, most goals in the European Championship (14), most international goals by a male player (115), and most international appearances by a European male (184). He is one of the few players to have made over 1,100 professional career appearances, and has scored over 800 official senior career goals for club and country.

uncertainties.detail: Private beneficial-ownership documents were not located. Resolution rests on an exact public My Mare attribution, an official registry match for name, length and Portuguese registration, and the same source record's independently corroborated CG Mare association. This multi-anchor chain clears the identity threshold but keeps confidence below 100.

Official sources give the full legal name Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro, while the database intentionally uses the established public name Cristiano Ronaldo and already stores Ronaldo as the last-name value. The dossier corrects whitespace only and does not speculate about redistributing Portuguese name elements across middle-name and surname fields.

No main residence is proposed because club location, property holdings and legal residence are not interchangeable and can change. No strong source established a secondary nationality, so that field remains blank.

The ontology has no professional-earner category. Operator is selected because Ronaldo personally performs and licenses the athletic and image work that creates the core income; Founder would overstate the relationship to every endorsement and consumer venture.

No LinkedIn profile is proposed. X, YouTube and the personal website have first-party or institutional verification. Instagram is retained at very-high rather than absolute confidence because direct platform retrieval was restricted, although FIFA and Ronaldo's official digital ecosystem consistently identify the account.
